game.title: Humankind
game.blurb: Historical turn-based 4X strategy game where you lead a people through the eras, from Amplitude Studios, released 2021-08-17. RAWG average playtime: 8 hours. Genre: Strategy. Chapters follow the play themes the Steam achievements show.

chapters.title: Eras, Era Stars and Progress
chapters.summary: Leaving the Neolithic Era, reaching each era, Era Stars, technology, affinities and playing turns.

chapters.title: Cities, Resources and Trade
chapters.summary: Food, industry, money and science per turn, big cities, forests, railways, resources and trade routes.

chapters.title: Wonders, Curiosities and Exploration
chapters.summary: Cultural Wonders, Curiosities, Landmarks, Wondrous Luxuries and reaching new continents.

chapters.title: Diplomacy, Religion and Independent Peoples
chapters.summary: Alliances, spheres of influence, ideology, religions, Holy Sites and assimilating Independent Peoples.

chapters.title: War, Armies and Nuclear Weapons
chapters.summary: Winning wars and battles, killstreaks, hiring armies, vassals and lieges, and nuclear weapons.

chapters.title: Victories and AI Difficulty
chapters.summary: Winning on higher AI difficulties and map sizes, and finishing games under special conditions.

chapters.title: Multiplayer and Mods
chapters.summary: Finishing a turn with another human player and the official ENDLESS mod. Multiplayer needs a network connection.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). No StrategyWiki page under "Humankind" or "HUMANKIND". On humankind.fandom.com the page "Humankind" is the wiki's own front page, so "HUMANKIND", which redirects to "Humankind (video game)", was used instead; it answers the API with about 22 linked pages, such as the six eras from "Neolithic Era" to "Contemporary Era", "Culture", "Fame" and "Narrative Event"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. App 1124300 is "HUMANKIND™"; the Steam app list also has "HUMANKIND™ 2" (2581850), a different game. None of the 99 Steam achievements is hidden. Strategy game, so chapters follow play themes rather than a story. Some achievements fit more than one theme (for example winning a game without declaring war is under victories, not war); the first matching theme wins. Fandom also links pages for several culture packs and the "Together We Rule Expansion Pack", but no achievement names them.
